title: A general proof of integer Rényi QNEC
summary: We prove the Rényi quantum null energy condition for every integer Rényi order $n\geq2$. In local Poincaré-invariant quantum field theory, this states that the sandwiched Rényi divergence (SRD) of an excited state relative to the vacuum is convex along a future-directed null deformation. We assume that the deformation is realized by the canonical translations of a half-sided modular inclusion and that the divergence is finite for the initial, undeformed algebra.
